scope: CPU-only local linear shared-plus-block-sparse FFN-output diagnostic; no BPB, generation, engine, cache-residency, throughput, or rate claim

protocol.mass_selector: float64 sum(z_i^2), stable descending sort, lower label wins exact ties
protocol.capture: x from MLP forward-pre-hook; z from down_proj forward-pre-hook
protocol.fit_order: calibration only; held-out scores are never supplied to the fit
protocol.rank_zero: combined r=0 is exactly sparse-only, not a fitted zero-output arm
protocol.shared_only: rank 32/64/128 fit y directly and omit selected groups at score time; only rank 64 participates in the preregistered verdict
